metadata.PDF_filename: Dean et al. 2025 3 compartment (PFOA, PFOS, PFHxS).pdf
metadata.Title: Adapting existing toxicokinetic models to relate perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl intake to biomarkers in humans
metadata.Authors: Dean KJ, Verner MA, Caron-Beaudoin E, Ayotte P, et al.
metadata.Extraction_notes: Gold-standard benchmark model with saturable renal resorption

structure.Distribution_process: Receives absorbed oral dose; exchanges with deep compartment and renal filtrate
Central ⇄ Deep via k12 and k21
Central → filtrate by filtration; filtrate → central by saturable resorption; unreabsorbed amount is excreted
